title: Decouple data preparation from model definition
description:
This PR will decouple dataset preparation from the model definition. 
This will allow us to almost transparently use luz for model training, which will be the prefered API.

title: Refactor `predict`
description:
- No more `mode`. 
- Allow passing a `past_data` that by default uses the same data as the model has been trained. (we could perhaps only save the last `lookback` values to save memory).
- [x] Add a function to make it easier to create splits of the data for prediction.
